data.name: PanzenTD
data.detailed_description:
PanzenTD is a charming and strategic tower defense game where nature strikes back! Take control of heroic panda warriors defending their homeland from waves of chaotic, machine-powered invaders.

Set in a lush, hand-painted world, PanzenTD blends accessible gameplay with strategy. Build towers, deploy unique panda heroes like Pambo and Edizen, and stop the relentless advance of chainsaw-wielding robots, bulldozer tanks, and other mechanical threats.

Whether you're defending bamboo groves in story mode or designing your own levels, Panzen TD delivers tactical fun wrapped in a vibrant, lighthearted style.

Key Features

  • Hero Panda Roster: Command a growing cast of powerful pandas, each with distinct abilities and personalities.

  • Unique Robot Enemies: Face creatively designed enemies - from circular-saw arms to plowfront tanks.

  • Stylized Map Design: Fight across themed levels like the Bamboo Forest, Battlegrounds, and more.

  • Tower Progression System: Upgrade and evolve your towers with meaningful choices and visual feedback.

  • Custom Level Editor: Create and test your own maps using an intuitive in-game editor.

  • Gameplay Modifiers: Add challenge and variety with stackable rule-changing modifiers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for low to mid-range hardware. Higher settings and content updates may require stronger specs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for high-quality visuals and smooth gameplay with custom maps or large enemy waves.
